rules.description: Property must be in England or Northern Ireland
rules.reason_if_failed: SDLT applies only to properties in England and Northern Ireland. Use Land and Buildings Transaction Tax for Scotland, or Land Transaction Tax for Wales.

rules.description: Return must be filed within 14 days of completion
rules.reason_if_failed: SDLT return must be filed within 14 days of completion. You may face penalties and interest charges for late filing.

rules.description: For residential property, SDLT applies if purchase price exceeds threshold
rules.reason_if_failed: No SDLT is due on residential properties under £125,000 (or £300,000 for eligible first-time buyers), but you must still file a return.

rules.description: For non-residential/mixed property, SDLT applies if purchase price exceeds £150,000
rules.reason_if_failed: No SDLT is due on non-residential properties under £150,000, but you must still file a return for most transactions.

rules.description: Transaction must be a chargeable property purchase or transfer
rules.reason_if_failed: This transaction type may be exempt from SDLT. Check exemptions guidance.

explanation_template: SDLT liability: {outcome}. Purchase price: £{purchase_price}. Property type: {property_type}. Estimated SDLT: £{calculated_sdlt}.

edge_cases.description: Solicitor or conveyancer is handling the transaction
edge_cases.action: Agent-based filing. Confirm solicitor will file on your behalf. If not, proceed with self-filing.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is eligible for first-time buyer relief (residential property up to £500k, first home)
edge_cases.action: Apply first-time buyer relief: 0% up to £300k, 5% on £300k-£500k. Verify all purchasers are first-time buyers.

edge_cases.description: Applicant already owns residential property (5% surcharge applies)
edge_cases.action: Add 5% surcharge to all SDLT rates. Check if replacing main residence within 36 months for potential refund.

edge_cases.description: Purchaser is not a UK resident (2% surcharge applies)
edge_cases.action: Add 2% non-UK resident surcharge. May be eligible for refund if become UK resident within specified period.

edge_cases.description: Property purchased through shared ownership scheme
edge_cases.action: Offer choice: (1) market value election (pay SDLT on full market value once), or (2) pay in stages. Complex calculation required.

edge_cases.description: New leasehold purchase requires net present value calculation for rent
edge_cases.action: Calculate SDLT on both lease premium and NPV of rent. If NPV > £125k (residential) or £150k (non-residential), 1% rate applies to excess.

edge_cases.description: Purchasing 6 or more residential properties in single transaction
edge_cases.action: Non-residential rates apply. No multiple dwellings relief available since April 2024.

edge_cases.description: Transaction may be exempt (gift, inheritance, divorce, under £40k)
edge_cases.action: Verify exemption applies. No SDLT due and no return required for most exempt transactions.
Late filing penalties apply. Immediate handoff to HMRC compliance. Agent cannot file late returns without manual review.
